mapper.insert: INSERT INTO snapshot_item (snapshot_id, item_name, quantity, category, is_checked, notes, order_index) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{itemName}, #{quantity}, #{category}, #{isChecked}, #{notes}, #{orderIndex})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM snapshot_item WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY order_index
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM snapshot_item WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND item_name = #{itemName}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM snapshot_item WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}
